title: Deformation theorem, scaled version (Simon 5.1/5.3)
statement: For all m, ℓ ∈ ℕ with ℓ ≥ 1 there is C = C(m,ℓ) ∈ [0,∞) such that for every T ∈ D_{m+1}(ℝ^{m+1+ℓ}) with M(T) + M(∂T) < ∞ and every ρ > 0 there are β : 𝓛_{m+1}(ρ) → ℝ, Pc = Σ_F β_F[[F]] (IsLatticeChain ρ β Pc), R ∈ D_{m+2}(ℝ^{m+1+ℓ}) and S ∈ D_{m+1}(ℝ^{m+1+ℓ}) with T − Pc = ∂R + S, M(Pc) ≤ C M(T), M(∂Pc) ≤ C M(∂T), M(R) ≤ CρM(T), M(S) ≤ CρM(∂T), spt Pc ∪ spt R ⊆ {dist(·, spt T) < 2√(m+1+ℓ)ρ}, spt ∂Pc ∪ spt S ⊆ {dist(·, spt ∂T) < 2√(m+1+ℓ)ρ}; if T is integer multiplicity then every β_F ∈ ℤ and Pc, R are integer multiplicity, and if moreover ∂T is integer multiplicity then S is integer multiplicity.
